pages.title: reconstruction_architecture_p21
pages.description: Draw one coherent left-to-right method figure with a narrow input column, a broad dual-path scientific model, a dominant three-kernel ensemble, compact outputs, and a thin validation strip. LEFT INPUTS: show Sparse wells as black points with coordinates and porosity labels {(s_i,z_i)}; below show Registered 3-D context as a real seismic cube with inline, crossline and time axes and label X in R^(B x 3 x H x W x D). BLUE TOP PATH: Sparse wells enter Ordinary kriging, with a compact variogram glyph gamma(h), neighborhood weights lambda_i and equation z_OK(s_0)=sum_i lambda_i z_i, sum_i lambda_i=1; output a blue baseline volume. ORANGE LOWER PATH: Registered 3-D context is divided into 3-D patches, enters a Frozen OpenMind-MAE block with a visible lock icon, patch embedding and four stacked ResEncL stages, then outputs volumetric features U in R^(N x 96). Immediately show Train-only scaling followed by PCA latent, with the short formula u_i=PCA(Std(U_i)); make clear by arrow placement that only training rows fit these transforms. TEAL CENTRAL METHOD: a Metric builder concatenates normalized registered coordinates, vertical anisotropy z x 4, seismic attributes weighted by s, and latent features weighted by f=0.1. Show compact formula m_s(s_i)=[x_i,y_i,4z_i,s a_i,0.1u_i]. Split this metric into exactly three parallel branches labelled s=0, s=0.1, s=0.2. Each branch contains 64-NN retrieval, a small neighborhood graph, inverse-distance weights w_ij proportional to d_ij^(-1.5), and one Local kernel prediction k_s(s_0). Merge the three branches at a Fixed mean operator. Then combine with the blue baseline volume at one Blend operator using the exact equation z_hat(s_0)=0.25 z_OK(s_0)+0.75 mean_s k_s(s_0). Do not show per-fold model selection. RIGHT OUTPUTS: a green Registered porosity volume, then two compact diagnostic cards labelled Orthogonal slices and Directional variograms. BOTTOM GREY STRIP: show Spatial 5-fold, 512 train labels per fold, 2,048 validation points per fold, Frozen parameters, and Same-field historical transfer; connect this strip only to evaluation, not to the forward prediction arrows. Key arrows carry compact dimensions. The foundation-model and neighborhood internals occupy most of the canvas. Do not include LoRA, Adapter, residual head, cross-attention, consistency gate, random initialization, learned gate g(s), ablation rail, result numbers, positive claims, blocked status, or safe fallback wording. Keep all visible labels exactly as specified and short.
